entries.05383c0d51a79c44: KAJIMA CORPORATION forms a group with 219 subsidiaries and 106 affiliated companies. The parent has business headquarters for civil engineering, building, development and others, which formulate strategy, while domestic affiliates handle the sale of construction materials, specialized construction, leasing and building leasing, and overseas affiliates carry out construction and development businesses in North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The reportable segments are five: civil engineering, building, development and others, domestic affiliates, and overseas affiliates, and a feature is that the [[term:segment|segment]] division combines the parent's business divisions with the affiliates' regional divisions.

entries.65f01f379bd19bb2: Operating income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥240,780 million and ordinary income was ¥240,420 million. Segment profit (on an operating income basis) was ¥83.2 billion for the building business, ¥76.7 billion for civil engineering, ¥35.7 billion for domestic affiliates, ¥26.6 billion for overseas affiliates and ¥17.6 billion for development and others. The company explains that, mainly due to steady progress in domestic construction projects and an improvement in the gross profit margin, revenue and profit increased for five consecutive periods.

entries.66f6116fad3e8e84: By customer location, revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,972.1 billion in Japan, ¥615.5 billion in North America (of which the United States ¥615.4 billion), ¥207.4 billion in Asia, ¥184.6 billion in Oceania, ¥83.2 billion in Europe and ¥4.1 billion in other regions. No single customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. Completed construction revenue of KAJIMA CORPORATION on a non-consolidated basis was ¥1,613.6 billion, broken down into ¥1,277 billion from the private sector in Japan, ¥333.6 billion from government agencies in Japan and ¥2.9 billion from overseas.

entries.7546cd942c6b1dca: Domestic affiliated companies carry out businesses mainly within Japan. Daikoh Bussan Co., Ltd. sells construction materials and equipment, Kajima Mechatronics Engineering Co., Ltd. supplies construction machinery, and Kajima Road Co., Ltd., Chemical Grout Co., Ltd., Clymatec Co., Ltd. and Ilia Co., Ltd., among others, undertake specialist construction works, part of which is ordered by Kajima Corporation. In addition, Kajima Lease Co., Ltd. carries out general leasing, Kajima Building Management Co., Ltd. carries out building management, Kajima Tokyo Development Co., Ltd. carries out building leasing and hotel operation, Forest Park Golf Club Co., Ltd. operates a golf course, and Atami Infrastructure Management GK operates and manages a toll road.

entries.f9a4010802ebc33e: The company undertakes civil engineering and building works from clients and recognizes the portion constructed and delivered as completed construction revenue. Specialized works and procurement of materials and equipment are placed with domestic affiliates such as Taiko Bussan Co., Ltd., Kajima Road Co., Ltd. and Chemical Grout Co., Ltd., while overseas construction and development are carried out under regional management companies such as Kajima U.S.A. It also runs a business in which it develops real estate for sale or lease. In the construction business, order intake (the value of construction contracts received) and completed construction revenue (recorded as revenue in the period) are different figures; for KAJIMA CORPORATION on a non-consolidated basis, order intake for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,275.3 billion, revenue including completed construction revenue was ¥1,710 billion, and the carried-forward backlog at period end was ¥3,116 billion.
